design.order: At clock low: apply reset or enqueue each asserted offer once; present queue head. At rising edge accept only pre.valid and pre.ready. Remove at most one head per channel after sampling; next head appears next cycle.
design.idle_payload: Hold last presented payload until another head or hardware reset; unused request payload fields have no effect.
design.reset: Original asynchronous active-low; cancel all not-yet-accepted offers, zero visible payload, log IDs/counts. No offers during reset. Original 8-cycle seed unchanged at DUT pins.
design.eof: Stop after exactly requested cycles, retain/log pending requests; no drain, hidden wait cycle or extra handshake. Pending carries across refinement through deterministic cumulative replay.
design.conservation: offered = accepted + hardware_reset_cancelled + pending, separately for command and TX.
design.scope: Original widths; enable=1/sw_reset=0 after seed; no dummy, speed3 or Dual/Quad bidirectional. Original checker unchanged.
design.feedback: Same public specification/RTL/history and raw coverage pagination; all arms also get requested actions versus actual pins and transport pending/accepted/reset-cancelled counts. No automatic coverage targeting or solver stimulus.

development_stop_rule: Exactly one new three-repetition development run after offline/Claude gates. Keep all failed rounds; no selective replacement. C only after passing.
